items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: And I remember that Bill Bottoms was a part of that building under the supervision of Doc Johnson.

ctx.x: That was Doc Johnson, yeah. Yeah, that was Doc Johnson. See, he owned that building, and he... And I remember that Bill Bottoms was a part of that building under the supervision of Doc Johnson. Mm-hmm. See? So... And I'm thinking... See, it was two brothers of those Johnsons, and the older brother owned the building. And in the later years, the younger brother, the big tall fellow of Dr. Johnson, is as close as I can recall.
Was Bottoms responsible for the redecoration and putting in a raised bandstand and finding glass floor and so forth? Do you think that...
